- alternatives: None documented in the provided text.
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing temporal metagenomics or microbiome datasets with paired samples from the same individuals to assess microbiota stability over time.
- pitfalls: The package is deprecated in Bioconductor 3.23 and is scheduled for removal, so users should refer to the package end-of-life guidelines or use the last stable release version.

workflows.name: microbiota_stability_analysis
workflows.intent: Analyze and visualize the temporal stability of individual microbiotas using iterative clustering on paired samples.
input: paired_microbiome_data.rds (TreeSummarizedExperiment or SummarizedExperiment containing temporal microbiota abundance profiles for paired individual samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Subset samples from paired time points ;; 2. Run iterative clustering using the Hartigan-Wong k-means algorithm to stress-test paired samples ;; 3. Validate the stability results ;; 4. Visualize the stability output
